executive_summary:
Bank Islam verified Q2 attributable-profit growth9.8%, with dated reported capital17.8% and impaired financing0.98%, preserves a possible recovery scenario. Near-flat H1 profit prevents extrapolating that one better quarter into a sustained earnings path; industrial cash-flow analogies are inappropriate for assessing the bank.

Sparse new issuer evidence, absent validated valuation and a larger daily trend below both major averages weaken the immediate-add case. Marginal positive MACD is accompanied by low volume rather than strong reversal confirmation. Neutral adopts the manager verdict against immediate averaging down, without turning the unconfirmed recovery into an automatic liquidation instruction.
